chandogya_chapter1_verse1.title: Chandogya Chapter 1 Verse 1
chandogya_chapter1_verse1.introduction: This verse belongs to Chandogya, Chapter 1.
chandogya_chapter1_verse1.scripture_text: A representative contemplative passage from the Chandogya Upanishad, Chapter 1, Verse 1, reflecting the inquiry into Atman, Brahman, and liberation through self-knowledge.
chandogya_chapter1_verse1.philosophical_explanation: This verse extends the contemplative teaching tradition of the Upanishads toward self-knowledge and liberation.
